tasks.role: Optional independent evaluation with authorized external ground truth. No Scanning or Score Task face exists in b05 yet.

gaps: Define the independent Labeling at Scale Job type; b05 currently has a preview model and no Job or Task folders.

The proposed Scanning name consolidates Qualify executor, Run batches, Audit labels and Package labels. These are operations, not four registered Task Types. The optional eval Task needs separate authorized ground truth.
